title: 7AA.1 partial DIMASSOC DXF group-70/71 mapping
mode: local implementation slice with primary-source contract
scope: Correct DXF DIMASSOC scalar mapping for group 70 trans-space and group 71 rotated-dimension type
Preserve existing parser field types, writer widths, and record framing
Use only generated ASCII/Binary checks and existing test registrations

sources.observed: DIMASSOC code 70 is the trans-space Boolean; code 71 is rotated dimension type (parallel/perpendicular). Codes 330, 90, and the osnap reference fields remain separate.
The prior DXF parser/writer mapped the public trans-space and rotated-type fields to the opposite group codes. The changed code corrects only DXF parse/write; DWG parse/encode paths were not touched.

implementation.parser: Group 70 now sets m_isTransSpace; group 71 validates the existing 0..255 storage range and sets m_rotatedDimensionType.
implementation.writer: Emits group 70 from m_isTransSpace, followed by group 71 from m_rotatedDimensionType, preserving the existing 16-bit writer calls.
limitations: Typed osnap references still do not represent all subentity, marker, parameter, intersection, and xref fields.
Loss guard and raw carrier remain responsible for unsupported DIMASSOC detail.
This does not implement live associative updates or prove DWG object-layout correctness.
